findings.finding: We set sides: a=F_{n+2}, b=F_{n+1}+t, c=F_n+t (t>0). Incircle gives D at (F_n,0). Using geometry, the cyclic condition K‑N‑K'‑B forces a unique t solving f(t)=0 (found numerically). For that t the ratio R=(CT·NB)/(BT·NE) simplifies to R=F_{n+2}/F_{n-1}. Hence a_n=F_{n+2}/F_{n-1}. For even indices a_{2n}=F_{2n+2}/F_{2n-1}→φ³=2+√5. So α=2+√5 ⇒ p=2,q=5. Compute ⌊2^{5²}⌋=2^{25}=33 554 432; 33 554 432 mod 99991 = 57447.

Use BD=s−b=Fₙ, CD=s−c=Fₙ₊₁ ⇒ sides: a=Fₙ₊₂, b=Fₙ₊₁+t, c=Fₙ+t (t>0). Cyclic K,N,K′,B uniquely fixes t. Compute ratio (CT·NB)/(BT·NE)=a/Fₙ₋₁=Fₙ₊₂/Fₙ₋₁. Hence a_{2n}=F_{2n+2}/F_{2n-1}→φ³=2+√5. p=2,q=5 →⌊2^{5²}⌋ mod 99991=57447. Pitfall: ensure correct t solving cyclic condition; ratio simplifies to Fₙ₊₂/Fₙ₋₁.
